name: Zoomlion Heavy Ind.S.&T.Co.LtdR
summary: Zoomlion Heavy Ind.S.&T.Co.LtdR: Zoomlion Heavy Industry Science and Technology Co., Ltd. is a Chinese manufacturer of engineering and construction machinery. The company produces a wide range of products including mobile cranes, concrete machinery, and earthmoving equipment. Zoomlion is headquartered in Changsha, Hunan, China.
